narratives.body: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel is set to end a 27-year streak of playing against the Chicago Bears in the Thanksgiving game, according to Yahoo Sports. Meanwhile, despite Christian Gonzalez announcing an illness, the Pats Pulpit reports he is good to play in the upcoming matchup.
narratives.headline: Vrabel ends 27-year TNF streak vs. Bears; Gonzalez ready despite illness

narratives.body: The Chicago Tribune reports that the Bears are considering a move away from Soldier Field, though specific details regarding the potential relocation remain unconfirmed.
narratives.headline: Bears considering move from Soldier Field
